record.title: microduck-eye-ring — the eye bezel: Pollen Robotics' published mesh `noenoeil` (Ø30.000 × 7.5 mm ring, Ø14.4 bore), mesh-backed part
record.why: GOAL.md finding 1 said the product's eye bezel is missing from the sim meshes; it is this mesh. Against the product photographs (out/head/head.json): front view eye OD / head width 0.3353 vs mesh 0.3226 (+1.16 mm implied on Ø30.000); profiles, scale-free, -0.14 ± 0.42 mm; verdict at the 1.5 mm rule CANNOT DETERMINE. Whether the mesh builds as a closed solid is read off bin/cad part:microduck-eye-ring.
record.origin_why: the geometry is the vendor's own published sim asset, loaded unchanged (tools/head_eye_ring_shelve.py, 2026-09-02). Not our design; usable to assemble, render, simulate and print; NOT licensed for sale (NC).
record.why_this_folder_exists: spec/mesh-to-part.json maps noenoeil here; the folder was created empty on 2026-09-01 and filled by lane A (head) on 2026-09-02
